source.title: Source
source.description: Book source to scrape. Source-specific options are shown below; do not combine options from different sources.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Comma-separated list of lang codes to filter export to (preferably ISO 639-1, else ISO 639-3) Defaults to all

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: Formats to include. Leave empty to include all supported formats.

zim_file.title: ZIM Filename
zim_file.description: Custom ZIM filename; computed from ZIM Name otherwise.

zim_title.title: Title
zim_title.description: Custom title for your project and ZIM.

zim_languages.title: ZIM Languages
zim_languages.description: ZIM Language metadata; comma separated ISO-639-3 language codes expected

zim_tags.title: ZIM Tags
zim_tags.description: Semicolon-separated ZIM tags. Overrides the selected source's default tags; for example: _category:medical;gutenberg.

books.title: Books
books.description: Source catalog positions or ranges, separated by commas. Open Textbook Library positions refer to eligible catalog entries. Defaults to all.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of concurrent threads to use

title_search.title: Title search
title_search.description: Search by title feature (⚠️ does not scale)

no_index.title: No Full-text Index
no_index.description: Do not create ZIM with full-text index

lcc_shelves.title: Library of Congress Shelves (Project Gutenberg only)
lcc_shelves.description: Comma-separated LCC shelf codes to include (e.g., P,PR,Q). Use 'all' for every shelf. Do not use with Open Textbook Library.

subjects.title: Subjects (Open Textbook Library only)
subjects.description: Comma-separated Open Textbook Library subjects to include. Do not use with Project Gutenberg.

otl_ids.title: Textbook IDs (Open Textbook Library only)
otl_ids.description: Comma-separated exact Open Textbook Library record IDs. Cannot be combined with Books.

stats_filename.title: Stats filename
stats_filename.description: Scraping progress file. Leave it as `/output/task_progress.json`

output.title: Output folder
output.description: Output folder for ZIM file(s). Leave it as `/output`

mirror_url.title: Mirror URL
mirror_url.description: URL to a source mirror or API base. Defaults to the selected source's standard endpoint.
